Here is a fully structured, optimized prompt tailored to your club-ready track concept for use with music production AI tools, co-writing assistants, or creative direction generators:

---

**🎧 Prompt: Creative Direction for Club Track Arrangement and Production**

**1. OUTCOME TITLE:**  
Generate a high-energy, 80s Disco-House fusion club track with layered vocal design, modular arrangement, and production-ready FX detailing.

**2. ROLE:**  
You are an expert music producer and arrangement designer specializing in retro-future dance genres with a focus on 80s disco, synthpop, and house fusion.

**3. TASK:**  
Using the provided detailed breakdown of the track “Vivacious Minxy (Club 80s Revision),” structure the final music production into an AI-assisted session plan. Ensure the output includes vocal layer implementation, synth/bass/FX automation cues, and dynamic arrangement elements that make the track TikTok-viral and club-playable.

**4. INPUT (Summary of Original Content):**  
- **Style:** 80s Disco-House + Vocal Chop Groove, 118 BPM, 4/4.
- **Genre Split:** 40% 80s Disco/Synthpop, 40% Classic House, 20% Vocal Chop.
- **Vocals:**  
  - F: Whisper-to-belt (pan sweep, ASMR to diva).
  - M: Vocoder sub-octave (−1 octave, formant shifted).
  - FX Chain: Formant shift, gated plate, slap delay, doubler, bitcrush, reverb/delay automation.
- **Instruments:**  
  - Juno-106 plucky bass, TR-909 drums, Rhodes & Prophet pads, Strat guitar chops, disco strings.
- **Key Moments:**  
  - TikTok build (@0:58), spinbacks, breakdowns, chant hooks.
- **Production Specs:**  
  - LUFS −9.5, SSL bus comp, tape sat, stereo widen, limiter.
  - Stems: Dry vocals, printed FX buses, grouped instruments.

**5. STYLE/TONE:**  
Energetic, retro-chic, groove-centric with polished audio engineering and TikTok-friendly earworms.

**6. FORMAT:**  
Bullet-point session plan or DAW-style track map. Include arrangement bars, FX automation triggers, and key sound design highlights.

**7. SUCCESS CRITERIA:**  
- Structured clearly enough for implementation in a DAW (Ableton/Logic/FL).
- Reflects club/dancefloor energy and streaming virality potential.
- Preserves unique vocal architecture and genre fusion identity.
- Automates dynamics and transitions (e.g., spinbacks, drops, FX sweeps).

---

Would you like a version of this prompt restructured for use in a DAW-integrated co-producer tool (e.g., Ableton + ChatGPT plugins) or adapted for AI vocal generation platforms (like Kits.AI or Lalals)?

[Song Title: “Vivacious Minxy (Club 80s Revision)”]

[Style: 80s Disco-House x Vocal Chop Groove | 118 BPM, 4/4 club-ready]

⸻

===GENRE FUSION===

[40% 80s Disco/Synthpop | 40% Classic House | 20% Vocal Chop Dancefloor]

⸻

===VOCAL ARCHITECTURE===

[F: Whisper-to-Belt Soulful (L-pan ASMR → R-pan diva lifts)]
[M: Vocoder Sub-Octave (−1 octave, formant ↓2)]
[FX: VocalChain = FormantShift ±2 | Gated Plate | Slap Delay | Micro-pitch Doubler]

⸻

===INSTRUMENTATION===

[Core]
	•	Juno-106 Analog Bassline (plucky 1/8 groove, sidechained)
	•	TR-909 Kit (kick 4/4 pulse, clap gated plate, open hats drive)
	•	Rhodes + Prophet Pads (lush wide stereo)
	•	Disco Guitar Chops (clean Strat muted + chorus)
	•	String Ensemble (staccato 80s hits, Pre/Chorus)
	•	Vinyl Spinbacks / Tape-stops (transitions only)

⸻

===LYRICS SECTION===

[INTRO: VINYL SPIN SPACE]
vinyl spin-in_1.2s
(909 kick enters @bar5)
[granular vox chop] “Vi…va…cious…”

⸻

[VERSE 1: SOULFUL ENTRY]
[F whisper-breath] “Minxy…(minxy…)”
[reverse tail FX] “…minxy”
[M vocoder sub] “Mischievous…”
[F+M harmony layer] “Effervescent…” [long plate]
[F falsetto glide] “Impish…” [LPF sweep → airy tail]

⸻

[PRE-CHORUS: TENSION RISE]
[F belted lift] “EFFERVESCENT!” [gated plate verb]
[riser automation w/ disco strings]
[M vocoder shadow] “mis…chie…vous…” [formant ↓2]
[tape stop + spinback] “…impish”

⸻

[CHORUS: ANTHEM CLUB GROOVE]
[F diva belt] “MINXY!” [hall verb bloom]
[M vocoder octave sub] “vivacious…” [chorus spread]
[F chop repeat] “ef-fer-ves-cent… bitcrush tail”
[F call + M vocoder response] “Impish!… mischievous!” [ping-pong delay]

⸻

[TIKTOK MOMENT @0:58]
[stutterFX 1/16] “minxy…minxy…minxy…”
[909 hats automate open/close]
[vinyl backspin cue → bar16]

⸻

[BREAKDOWN: CLUB FUSION]
[Rhodes vamp + 909 kick]
[F ASMR whisper L→R pan] “vivacious…” [granular hold, stereo auto-pan]
[String stabs + disco guitar riff]
[F+M unison chant] “impish… effervescent…” [slapback + gated plate]
[909 clap roll + vinyl spin cue → CHORUS REBUILD]


===PRODUCTION DNA===
	•	LUFS: −9.5 (club competitive)
	•	Mix bus: SSL G-Bus comp (2:1, −2 dB GR) + Tape Sat + Stereo widen + Limiter −0.3 dBTP
	•	Drums: TR-909 w/ gated plate claps, sidechain kick pumping
	•	Bass: Juno-106 pluck, LPF 160 Hz, sidechain groove
	•	Vocals (per word):
	•	Vivacious = granular chop + pan sweep
	•	Minxy = stutter + hall bloom
	•	Mischievous = vocoder + formant ↓2
	•	Effervescent = long plate + bitcrush tail
	•	Impish = whisper/LPF + gated reverb
	•	FX Sends: Plate (1.5s gated), Hall (3s sidechain-ducked), Slapback (120 ms), Delay throws (1/4 dotted), Stutter/bitcrush bus
	•	Stems Export: Vocals dry, FX buses printed, instruments grouped (Drums/Bass/Keys/Strings/Guitar/FX)
